# dart

## Overview
Generated GrammarKit parser (DartParser) and token element type definitions (DartTokenTypes) for parsing Dart source files into PSI trees.

## Interface
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.DartParser
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.DartTokenTypes
- [./lexer/ABOUT.md](./lexer/ABOUT.md)
- [./psi/ABOUT.md](./psi/ABOUT.md)

## Invariants
- `DartParser` implements both `com.intellij.lang.PsiParser` and `com.intellij.lang.LightPsiParser`.
- Auto-generated by GrammarKit from [Dart.bnf](../../../../../src/main/java/com/jetbrains/lang/dart/Dart.bnf); edit the grammar, not these files.
- `DartParser` statically imports helpers from the hand-written `DartGeneratedParserUtilBase` (in `src/main/java/com/jetbrains/lang/dart/`).

## Side Effects
- Builds AST nodes (ASTNode) from lexer token streams during file parsing.
